dataset: Sourced code requirements for an insulation recommendation tool (pipes and ducts; hot, cold, condensate): duct insulation R-value tables and installed-R/compression rules, other pipe-insulation rules (IECC commercial and residential, IMC 1204, service hot water), condensate-drain insulation status, refrigerant-piping insulation, plenum fire ratings, and outdoor/UV protection

conventions.unverified: The literal string 'unverified' (or an entry in the top-level 'unverified' list) means no fetched source stated the item. Nothing was guessed, interpolated or filled from memory.
conventions.src: Every item carries 'src', a list of ids in this file's top-level 'sources' array (C1...C35). C34 and C35 are recorded only to document sources that could not be read.
conventions.ids: Requirement ids: DUCT-n, PIPE-n, COND-n, REF-n, FIRE-n, OUT-n.
conventions.quotes: 'quote', '*_quote' and '*_quotes' strings are verbatim from the page text or pdftotext output, with line breaks joined and runs of spaces collapsed. Every quote and every 'check' string was machine-verified as a substring of the downloaded source text when this file was built. Where a source shows an equation as an image, the image was read visually and the field name says so ('*_image_read').
conventions.check_fields: 'check' / 'check_*' / 'checks' fields are verification strings (table rows as they appear in the text, cells separated by ' | ' for UpCodes pages) that were matched against the source; they back up hand-transcribed numbers.
conventions.upcodes_formatting: UpCodes text loses superscripts: '11/2' means 1 1/2, 'ft2' means ft², a trailing 'a, c' after a table title is a footnote marker. Ranges such as '0.32—0.34' keep the em dash as served.
conventions.icc_via_state_adoptions: ICC model codes (IECC, IMC, IRC, IPC) were read from UpCodes pages of state adoptions whose header says "Adopts Without Amendments" (IPC: "Adopts With Amendments"); the edition shown is the model code edition named on that page.
conventions.summaries: Fields named 'note', 'finding', 'summary', 'parsed' or 'observation' are the agent's paraphrase or structured reading of the quotes; the quotes govern.
conventions.related_files: vapor-code-verified.json holds ASHRAE 90.1 pipe tables (2010/2019/2022), the K/k correction formula and vapor-retarder guidance; it is referenced, not duplicated.

condensate_drain.finding: No model code read (IMC 2021/2024, IRC 2021/2024, IPC 2021, ASHRAE 90.1-2019, IECC 2021/2024, UPC 2012 as adopted by Nevada) contains a requirement to insulate HVAC condensate drain lines.
